name: Federal District
summary: A white field with a green square in the centre holding the Cross of Brasília: four yellow arrows pointing outward, their feathers forming a lozenge.
origin: The poet Guilherme de Almeida created the flag, made official on 25 August 1969.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: Peace and the vast Brazilian territory.

symbols.name: Cross of Brasília
symbols.description: Four arrows pointing to the four directions.
symbols.meaning: Indigenous heritage and the capital's power reaching all directions; also the Southern Cross and the cross of the first Mass of 1500.

facts: The arrows' feathers form a lozenge echoing the national flag.
clues: Four yellow arrows forming a cross in a green square, on white.
The flag of a planned capital opened in 1960.
